name: Godrej Properties Ltd
title: Godrej Properties Ltd - 533150 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 bookings of INR10,163 crore and FY26 bookings INR34,171 crore (105% of guidance); FY27 guided to over INR39,000 crore, a 20% rise, with launch-led growth and cautious Middle East-related demand commentary.

triggers.label: FY27 bookings guided over INR39,000 crore
triggers.quote: we hope to grow residential bookings to over INR39,000 crores through the launch of a large number of exciting new projects

triggers.label: March Middle East impact ~INR1,000 crore
triggers.quote: we could have probably done INR1,000-odd crores more

triggers.label: Construction cost inflation 5-6% at max
triggers.quote: cost impact would be between 5% to 6% at max

guidance.quote: we hope to grow residential bookings to over INR39,000 crores
We expect to grow collections by 20% to over INR24,000 crores
our return on equity target of 20% by financial year '28
if we only add projects with INR20,000 crores, we 'll certainly be free cash positive

prior_guidance_check.quote: We, of course, are disappointed to have missed this INR21,000 crores guidance
achieving 12.1 million square feet of projects delivered across 9 cities, which was 121% of our annual guidance

red_flags.label: FY26 collections guidance missed by ~5%
red_flags.quote: We, of course, are disappointed to have missed this INR21,000 crores guidance

red_flags.label: Sustenance pricing weak in Gurgaon
red_flags.quote: on the Gurgaon side, I don't see there is a good price uptick

evasions.quote: very difficult to frankly give you a sense of what exactly Q1 number would look like
I think it's a little uncertain, to be honest, for FY 27
